text:
Lina - Marketing: Quick kickoff 1: need launch posts + one live micro-lab for "Starter Refapps" and an accompanying benchmark short. Targets: blog post, short HN announcement, email drip, and inbound routing rules. Can we land this by EOW?
Alejandra - DevRel: Yes. I'll own the repo and the 25m lab. Plan: repo + one-click run (docker) and a short terraform starter.
Jon - Growth: For subject lines: 'Ship a refapp in 30m' vs 'See our 3x cost wins' 1 will A/B test small segments. CTAs: 'Get the tutorial' vs 'Join the live run'.
Priya - Product: Bench details: include model variant, q4 quant, hardware comparison (A100 vs T4), and metrics: tokens/sec, p50/p99, tokens per $ 1 we'll provide a one-page reproducible config.
Eli - Growth Ops: Routing: refapp leads -> self-serve funnel with repo link + onboarding drip. bench leads -> nurture, tag 'bench-interest'; if team_size>50 -> notify SEs. Hidden field utm_campaign=community_micro_lab.
Lina - Marketing: Draft hero: 'Redwood Community Labs 1 hands-on refapps + live bench runs to make inference predictable and affordable. Free 301 min sessions.' Social snippets ready?
Jon - Growth: Two social variants: :rocket: Build a refapp in 30m. and :chart_with_downwards_trend: Real runs: 3x token cost reductions. Use utm_content to track creative.
Alejandra - DevRel: I'll include a small 'starter pack' with Dockerfile, minimal infra script, and a short 'what you need' checklist for attendees.
launch-bot: Reminder: planning sync in 24h. RSVP: Lina, Alejandra, Jon, Priya, Eli.
Lina - Marketing: Action items: Alejandra -> repo + starter pack (48h), Jon -> email variants + social (36h), Eli -> routing rules + tracking (24h), Priya -> bench artifacts (48h), Lina -> landing + publish schedule (36h). Adding GH issue and draft landing now: https://go.redwood/marketing/micro-lab-draft
Jon - Growth: I'll also wire up a 1-question feedback form post-session for messaging iteration.
